failures.description: smoke member failed: browser target closed mid-run (browser-use state read returned no result), agent never used the changed tools
failures.evidence: Member browser-smoke (agent dc2e5d53, run 20261106-100307-2109485): after browser step 9 the verifier failed 'Expected at least one handler to return a non-None result ... BrowserStateRequestEvent' and the worker log shows 'Page.screenshot: Target page, context or browser has been closed'; 8/8 supervisor recoveries then timeout at 451s vs 450s. The trajectory contains only goto/screenshot/evaluate/scroll_down: no hover, no drag, no rejected call. Passed in 4 earlier rounds on the same agent code; the same campaign's other browser members (webdecoy, account-locked, email-otp) passed. The diff changes only hover/drag dispatch, descriptions and the humanized drag path.
